description:

title: Storytelling Café: Immerse yourself in memories
location:
Vadozner Huus (Lageplan)
Städtle 14
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein
description:
Tell, listen and pause

In the storytelling café we meet in a relaxed atmosphere and share personal experiences on a specific topic, which is selected and accompanied by a moderator. This time on the topic "Ice cubes, lemon water and a summer dress: My most beautiful summer memories." We talk, listen and exchange ideas in an appreciative and respectful atmosphere. Nobody evaluates or judges. Everyone is allowed to contribute while the other participants listen.

The storytelling café takes place every two months on a Monday from 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. with coffee, tea and pastries.

Registrations at T +423 238 29 55 or eleonora.naegele(at)vaduz.li
